''See also: [[Wei Shi Lindon Arelius Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[Lindon|Wei Shi Lindon]] [[Arelius family|Arelius]] is a powerful [[sacred artist]] who has ascended through various ranks, including [[Underlord]], [[Archlord]], and [[Sage]]. Originally from the [[Blackflame territory]] and having grown up within the [[Wei clan]], he was adopted into a branch of the [[Arelius family]]. His progression has been supported by an [[Arelius Underlord]], specifically [[Eithan|Eithan Arelius]], who helped build his foundation and guided his development in the [[Path of Black Flame]]. [[Lindon]] is noted for practicing both a [[pure madra]] [[Path]] and an inherited [[fire and destruction]] [[Path]]. Throughout his journey, he has been associated with the [[Akura clan]] and has achieved significant status, including being named an [[Uncrowned King]] and a representative of the [[Reaper Division]]. His history is marked by intense combat, high-stakes duels, and complex relationships with major families and entities. He has also been identified as the individual responsible for the death of the [[Silent King]].}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[Lindon]] is the chosen of [[Akura Malice]] and serves as a representative for the prime [[Akura prime team{{!}}Akura team]]. He is connected to [[Yerin{{!}}Yerin Arelius]], who might be coerced into cooperation using him as a potential hostage. Additionally, he is noted to be in a fortress with [[Seishen Daji]] and has been addressed by [[Reigan Shen]].}}
